package.description: qTox is a chat, voice, video, and file transfer instant messaging client using the encrypted peer-to-peer Tox protocol

en-US.description: qTox is a chat, voice, video, and file transfer instant messaging client using the encrypted peer-to-peer Tox protocol
en-US.name: qTox
en-US.releaseNotes:
Release notes
A maintenance release fixing many bugs.
Also thanks to contributors, including translators for your continued support.

Bug Fixes
- enable experimental toxcore thread safety This is currently required for thread safe toxav operations. (5b5f4682)
- missing includes uncovered by clang-23 (515dcc74)
- various clang tidy reports (cc17033f)
- Fix OOM crash in SettingsSerializer readStream() VInt decoder. (7d46ee26)
- FriendRequests: Key request buttons by widget to prevent use-after-free (22a97df1)
- avatar: Add some checks for SVG avatars. (ec3a0bab)
- chatform:
  - diagnose friend going offline during call. (92e78693)
  - Do not interpret 祝 and 秘 as smileys. (d76ed925)
- cmake: nix shell command was sensitive to cwd (3f3033f2)
- core: Make DHT port selection truly random. (f6387e04)
- gcc: gcc related failed sfinae warnings (264f35b3)
- notify: Treat nicks and notifications as plain text. (8813ac90)
- video: uninitialized lock (fd47971b)

Features
- logging: Add toxcore log level and log-to-file settings. (6f502bac)
